slice: relay egress via fixed-destination CONNECT proxy, slice 1 (proxy + client use)
author: Claude Code (Opus 5.5)
decision: user 2026-11-24 (recommended option 3): fixed-destination egress proxy; TLS end to end; secrets stay in the relay; main Pod egress only to the proxy (renderer in slice 2)

proxy.request: one CONNECT line (HTTP/1.0|1.1) + exactly one matching Host header, <=4096 bytes
proxy.dns: every answer must be public IPv4; any private/CGNAT/loopback/link-local/metadata/IPv6/empty answer rejects
proxy.limits: 8 concurrent tunnels (503 beyond), idle 35s, lifetime 120s even with traffic

clients: PrepareConfig.egress_proxy: http://<in-cluster host>:<port> (None = direct, dev only)
TokenRepoReader: ProxyHandler only for the configured proxy; environment proxies never used; redirects still not followed

irsa_clients: on the botocore session before the resolver is built: region, regional STS, default client config with proxy/timeouts, dualstack off, FIPS off, ignore configured endpoint URLs; STS/ECR endpoints pinned to the regional hosts
product_fixes_found_by_tests: AWS_USE_DUALSTACK_ENDPOINT=true sent the web-identity provider's AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity to sts.ap-northeast-2.api.aws (not allowed by the proxy)
AWS_ENDPOINT_URL[_STS] redirected AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity, carrying the projected token, to an arbitrary host (proxy blocks; direct mode could leak)

mutation_checks.equivalent_reason: with botocore 1.44 the session region, disabled dualstack/FIPS and ignored endpoint URLs already guarantee the same regional hosts; kept as defense in depth
mutation_checks.runner: full inherited environment, baseline must pass first; AWS profile files absent (CI-like)
strengthened: explicit lifetime check independent of select timeout
adversarial AWS_* environment (legacy STS, dualstack, FIPS, endpoint URL overrides, other region, env proxies)
